## Overview

Part of the [**Data Science Projects Collection**](https://github.com/PaulChanCyber/Data-Science-Project-) (Cambodian motocycle comuser analysis)—Consumer behavior analysis in Cambodia's motorcycle market—brands, price bands, and purchase patterns.

## Problem & Data

Manufacturers and dealers need visibility into how consumers trade off price, brand, and specifications.

## Approach

Market data scraping, segmentation analysis, and visualization of brand share and price elasticity proxies.

## Technologies

Python · pandas · Seaborn · Jupyter

## Outcomes

Segment profiles and trend charts supporting marketing and inventory decisions.
